item.title: Injured Rider Update - Adrian Layt (Bathurst Friday)
item.description: Jockey Adrian Layt was dislodged from his mount (Sharbino) when rounding the home turn in Race 1 at Bathurst on Friday. Adrian is experiencing neck discomfort and will be transported to hospital for further examination.
